raw.details:
About the Opportunity

SiliconSprint 2.0 is a 24-hour, national-level virtual electronics hackathon co-organized by IEEE NITK Surathkal and IEEE BITS Pilani Hyderabad Campus (IEEE BPHC), sponsored by Tenstorrent and powered by Unstop. Following an inaugural edition that drew over 650 registrations and 250+ teams nationwide, this second edition unites bright engineering undergraduates to tackle next-generation hardware design and real-world industry challenges.

Prizes & Rewards

  • Total Prize Pool: ₹1,00,000 (1 Lakh)
  • Cash Prizes: ₹80,000
  • Merchandise & Goodies: Official goodies worth ₹20,000
  • Certification: Official IEEE participation certificates for participants

Hackathon Tracks

  • Analog Frontier
  • Digital Frontier
  • Signal Processing Frontier
  • Hardware for AI Frontier

Event Timeline

  • Nov 23 (Day 1): Industry Expert Keynotes (Talks by 2 industrial experts)
  • Nov 25 (Day 2): Industry Expert Keynotes (Talks by 2 industrial experts)
  • Nov 27 (Part 1): Grand Opening & Kickoff (Official inauguration and event launch)
  • Nov 27 (Part 2): First Review (Initial milestone check and feedback round)
  • Nov 28 (Part 1): Second Review (Mid-stage review and refinement)
  • Nov 28 (Part 2): Final Review & Presentations (Final project presentations by participants)

Rules & Guidelines

  • Eligibility: Open to 1st, 2nd, and 3rd-year undergraduate engineering students.
  • Team Size: 2–3 members per team.
  • Originality: All submissions must be completely original; plagiarism is strictly prohibited.
  • Technical Specifications: Specific tools and problem statements will be disclosed upon registration.
  • Judging: Submissions will be evaluated by a panel of industry experts and academics.

Why Participate?

  • Solve Real-World Problems: Transition academic theory into high-impact hardware engineering.
  • Win Big & Get Certified: Compete for the ₹1,00,000 prize pool (₹80,000 cash + ₹20,000 worth of merchandise) and receive an official certificate from IEEE.
  • Network: Connect with top engineering talent, mentors, and recruiters across India.

Connect With Us

  • WhatsApp Community: https://chat.whatsapp.com/DpBT2pWoCFdBt4d3ggV3fX
